# The Carlson Law Firm

> Texas-based personal injury law firm with 17 locations across the state handling car accidents, truck wrecks, and injury claims.

The Carlson Law Firm is a multi-location personal injury practice serving clients throughout Texas, from Austin and San Antonio to West Texas and coastal areas. They specialize in motor vehicle accidents, maritime injuries, and wrongful death claims with local offices providing free consultations.
